attributes.title: 2027 Annual FMHCA Conference
attributes.cme_provider: Florida Mental Health Counselors Association (NBCC ACEP #2058)
attributes.summary:
The Florida Mental Health Counselors Association holds its 2027 Annual Conference February 4 to 6, 2027, at the Orlando Marriott Lake Mary. There is a separate registration for those who want to attend online. FMHCA is the Florida chapter of AMHCA and works only for licensed mental health counselors in the state.

Early-bird pricing runs through November 1, 2026. The public rate is $600 for three days, $400 for two days and $200 for one day, with lower rates for presenters. Members and students see their discounted rates only after signing in, so those amounts are not public. Regular rates after the early-bird period are not published.

FMHCA is an NBCC-Approved Continuing Education Provider (#2058) and says the CE earned at the conference applies nationally. The total number of conference CE hours is not published yet.
